sonnet.problem: The card cites Psalm 32:5-7 as a continuous range, but it only uses verse 5 (the hiding reference) and verse 7 (the quoted 'You are my hiding place'). Verse 6 is not used, so the citation is wider than the card.
sonnet.rule: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower. ... When a card uses verses that aren't next to each other, list them with commas, like `Psalm 132:9, 16`.

sonnet.problem: The punchline shape 'that's me at [situation]: [self-deprecating image]' repeats the one in Stop 1 card 9 ('That's me after twelve batches back to back by the ovens...'). It is the same joke shape used twice in one lesson, and it adds nothing new as a callback.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson. A callback is the one exception, and it adds something new.
